projects.title: DraftKings NFL Predictor Performance Analysis
projects.description:
This project rigorously evaluates the predictive capabilities of DraftKings' machine learning models for NFL game outcomes. By analyzing daily data, the project assesses model performance across various game types—close, blowout, and competitive—to identify potential betting advantages on specific days.

The project encompassed a comprehensive data pipeline, from the collection, cleaning, and storage of NFL outcomes and DraftKings predictions to their in-depth evaluation using a suite of ML evaluation and analytical techniques. To ensure secure and scalable access to the evaluation data, FastAPI was employed to create robust APIs for website integration. The infrastructure was built and deployed on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using Terraform for infrastructure as code, GitHub for version control, and Docker for containerization, provisioning a Virtual Machine instance. Finally, an interactive frontend was developed using Django to visualize the analysis and insights.
